title: How to Handle Taxes and Write-offs As A Walmart Spark Driver
summary: Filing taxes as a Walmart Spark driver? See which 1099 forms you'll get, the write-offs that cut your bill, the new tip deduction, and key deadlines.
body_markdown:
Driving for Walmart's[Spark Driver platform](https://drive4spark.walmart.com/) makes you an independent contractor. In the IRS's eyes that means taxes work differently than they would for a regular W-2 job. The good news: once you understand a few rules, filing is straightforward, and the right tax write-offs can save you hundreds on your taxes!


Keeper's guide covers everything you need for the 2026 tax year: the 1099 forms you'll receive (heads up: the rules changed this year), the write-offs that lower your bill, the deduction for tips (thanks OBBB!), and quarterly taxes.


## What taxes do Spark Driver platform drivers pay?


If you make $400 or more in profit on the Spark Driver platform, you'll owe two kinds of federal tax:[self-employment tax](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-is-self-employment-tax) and **income tax** .


For W-2 employees, their taxes are withheld by their employer. But Spark drivers aren't employees. In the eyes of the IRS, you're an independent contractor running your own small business, and the Spark Driver platform is essentially your client. TLDR: the IRS considers you self-employed, and you're on the hook for taking care of those taxes.


### 1. Self-employment tax


Also known as FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act),[self-employment tax](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-is-self-employment-tax) is how gig workers fund Social Security and Medicare. It's a flat **15.3%** of your net self-employment income. 12.4% for Social Security (on your first $184,500 of earnings in 2026) plus 2.9% for Medicare, which has no income cap.


W-2 employees pay only 7.65% and their employer covers the other half. Because you're self-employed, you have to 'cover both halves. Ouch! But there's a silver lining! You can[deduct half of your self-employment tax](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/how-to-file-self-employment-taxes-step-by-step) on your income taxes.


### 2. Federal and state income tax


On top of self-employment tax, your profit is subject to income tax. Federal income tax is progressive, ranging from **10% to 37%** depending on your total taxable income.


Your state tax rate depends on where you live. Some states charge a single flat rate, others use brackets, and these nine charge no personal income tax at all:


-


Alaska


-


Florida


-


Nevada


-


New Hampshire


-


South Dakota


-


Tennessee


-


Texas


-


Washington


-


Wyoming


For an estimate of your federal and state tax bills, try Keeper's[income tax calculator](https://www.keepertax.com/income-tax-calculator) .


## What 1099 forms do Spark drivers get?


For the 2026 tax year, most Spark drivers will receive a single form: 1099-NEC.


### Form 1099-NEC


The[1099-NEC](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/1099-nec-vs-1099-misc) reports all of your Spark earnings *and* tips. Under the[One Big Beautiful Bill Act](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/2025-tax-law-changes) , the reporting threshold rose from $600 to **$2,000** . So for 2026, Walmart is required to send you a 1099-NEC only if you were paid $2,000 or more.


### Form 1099-K


A[1099-K](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-is-form-1099-k) reports payments processed through third parties, but it's only required when you exceed **$20,000** in payments *and* **200 transactions** in a year.


### What if I don't receive a 1099?


Well, you still owe taxes. The IRS requires you to report *all* self-employment income, even if you earned under $2,000 and no form was issued. If your net profit is $400 or more, you have to file a return and pay[self-employment tax](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-is-self-employment-tax) .


Didn't get a 1099 tax form? Check out Keeper's tax guide on[what to do when you're missing a 1099 form](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-do-i-do-if-i-dont-receive-a-1099) .


## Can Spark drivers deduct their tips in 2026?


Yes! The federal "No Tax on Tips" deduction, created by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, lets eligible workers[deduct qualified tips](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/taxes-on-tips) from their taxable income for tax years 2025 through 2028. Delivery drivers are among the qualifying occupations - congratulations!


Here's the cliff notes:


-


You can deduct up to **$25,000** of qualified tips per year.


-


It lowers your *income* tax only - not your 15.3% self-employment tax! To lower your self-employment taxes, write off your business expenses!


-


It's an above-the-line deduction, so you can claim it even if you take the standard deduction.


-


The deduction phases out once your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) passes $150,000 ($300,000 if married filing jointly).


-


If you're self-employed, the deduction can't be more than your net business income, and you'll need a Social Security number to claim it.


## Which write-offs can Spark drivers claim?


Once you know your earnings, it's time to list your business expenses. Any cost that's "ordinary and necessary" for your work can be claimed as a[tax write-off](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/what-is-a-tax-deduction) , meaning it's both common in your line of work and helpful for doing your job.


Write-offs lower your taxable income, which lowers your tax bill. As a delivery driver, most of your expenses are likely[car-related](https://www.keepertax.com/tax-write-offs/postmates) . These might include:


-


🛡️ Car insurance


-


📄 Vehicle registration


-


🚗[Lease payments](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/car-lease-tax-write-off)


-


⛽[Gas](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/is-gas-deductible)


-


🅿️ Parking and toll fees


-


📉[Vehicle depreciation](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/car-depreciation-tax)


-


🛠️ Repair or maintenance


-


📱Cell phone accessories and a[portion of your phone bill](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/how-to-deduct-cell-phone-bill-on-taxes)


-


🛣️ Roadside assistance plans


-


🎶[Music services like Spotify or Apple](https://www.keepertax.com/posts/is-my-netflix-subscription-a-tax-write-off)


-


💵 Spark service fees and commissions


-


🥡 Trunk organizers or other delivery tools
